{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Has the P2P label and modifies peer socket event monitoring behavior to prevent continuous busy-spinning upon receipt of TCP urgent data.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Fixes a socket event-loop busy-spin triggered by TCP urgent data on established connections. Without this fix, receiving out-of-band data causes select() to repeatedly wake without standard recv() consuming the data, creating a potential CPU DoS condition that warranted a backport label."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes in src/test/sock_tests.cpp and test utilities merely test the socket behavior changes rather than test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Non-member; test additions directly verify the socket behavior fix rather than touching general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes the core socket abstraction in src/util/sock.h and src/util/sock.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects a defect in the Sock utility wrapper where select() monitored exception sets inappropriately on established sockets. Restricting exception monitoring to connection establishment fixes spurious readiness events across consumers of the utility."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 2,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 1,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
